title: CERT-In Vulnerability Note  CIVN-2026-0534
content:
CERT-In Vulnerability Note 
                                                                      CIVN-2026-0534
Denial of Service Vulnerability in Cisco product
Original Issue Date:November  02, 2026
Severity Rating: HIGH
Software Affected
Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software version 9.16 and prior, 9.18, 9.20, 9.22, 9.23, 9.24
Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software versions 7.0 and prior, 7.2, 7.4, 7.6, 7.7, 10.0, and 10.1
Overview
A vulnerability has been reported in Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software which could allow a remote attacker to cause denial of service (DoS) conditions on the targeted system.
Target Audience:
All organizations and individuals using affected versions of Cisco Secure Firewall ASA and FTD Software.
Risk Assessment:
High risk of service disruption.
Impact Assessment:
Potential for High risk of denial of service (DoS) conditions.
Description
Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software are security appliances used for firewall and VPN services.
This vulnerability exists in Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software due to logic errors when secondary authentication is configured on a tunnel group. A remote attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities by sending a specially crafted request when connecting to the SSL remote access VPN.
Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to cause denial of service (DoS) conditions on the targeted system.
Solution
Apply appropriate security as mentioned in CISCO advisory:
https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-asaftd-tunnel-dos-s6mgkb75
